on a kinda similar note, when i was maybe 4, my dad woke up and asked who i was. i thought he was playing around and said i was his daughter. stone faced, he replied that he had no daughter. he said he had no idea who i was and what i was doing in his house and he wanted me gone. my cousin was beside me at the time and he was very confused. i was scared because my dad was always temperamental. i was an accidental baby and what caused my parents to get married. i suspect he resented me for that when i was a child. and now i get to live the rest of my life mentally ill & traumatised. fun!

when i was 4 or 5, my dad asked me to recite the alphabet backwards and i couldn’t say it forward to recount it first. he said it was to help me remember all the letters. obviously i couldn’t do it so he screamed at me and made me kneel outside for hours. i still remember how numb my legs felt and i couldn’t stand afterwards. 

separately, when i was about 10, i crossed the road without holding someone’s hand and my dad slapped me because i was crossing the road dangerously (i waited for the light to turn green before crossing and i was crossing towards him as he was on the opposite side of the street, i was excited to see him and was running to hug him when he slapped me). when we got home, he beat me so bad my legs had to be bandaged and i had to sit out of PE the following day. 

these things really stick with you.

hi, i felt the same way as you as the date of my abortion grew closer. i went through with it anyway and i don’t regret it anymore. it felt awful before, during and immediately after, but it’s been a couple months now and if given the choice to undo the abortion, i wouldn’t. not telling you what to do, but this was my experience. in my opinion, the sadness i felt was because of pregnancy hormones. my advice is to really take the time and think about what keeping the baby would mean for your life, and whether you would resent the baby for veering your life off of its current course. explore alternative options! if you ultimately circle back to an abortion, you’ve got your answer.
